 HUNTR/X brings 'KPop Demon Hunters' craze back with new dance rehearsal video 
 By Miguel Paolo Togonon
 Oct 27, 2026 6:17 am 
 Just when you thought the KPop Demon Hunters craze had died down, think again — HUNTR/X is back with a new behind-the-scenes dance rehearsal video.
 Netflix released HUNTR/X's dance rehearsal for one of its biggest hits, "How It's Done," filmed in the style of real-life K-pop groups showcasing their choreography.
 But that's not all. Netflix will also release official choreography videos for HUNTR/X's "Golden" and "Takedown," as well as the Saja Boys' "Soda Pop" and "Your Idol."
 Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos also revealed that the sequel to KPop Demon Hunters is expected to receive a wide theatrical release. Deadline previously reported that the sequel is slated for release in 2029.
